name: Yukuhito no Pleroma
original_name: ゆくひとのプレーローマ
source:
As humans, space, and god meet their end, those who pass reach paradise. 
The first world and the last world of Gnostic mythology. 
Space has already converged, this is the outer world, where humans return, a filled paradise. 
Its name is Pleroma. 
A world created by 30 aions. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE232901.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
当人类、空间和神都迎来终结时，那些经过的人就会到达天堂。
诺斯替神话的第一个世界和最后一个世界。
空间已经收敛，这里是外界，人类回归的地方，一个充满的乐园。
它的名字是普莱罗马。
由30个永恒之塔创造的世界。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE232901.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
